title: Static plot
description: The free surface over the bed at the end of the run, in the thesis matplotlib style. Hand-written and short, so it reads as a figure script rather than a viewer: no timeline, no field selector, no branches beyond 1D versus 2D/3D. This is the default a case and its exported notebook open with. Pick the Field Viewer to scrub the timeline or choose another field.

title: Field Viewer
description: A field coloured on the mesh, via `zoomy_plotting.MatplotlibPlotter`. Unified 1D/2D/3D. Pick the field, scrub the timeline. A clean starting point — duplicate and edit to build your own view.

title: Mesh Viewer
description: Unified 1D/2D/3D interactive mesh visualization using Plotly. Rotate, pan, zoom with mouse. Edit `field_name` and `colormap`, use the timeline slider for snapshots.

title: Field + Vertical Profiles
description: The field on the mesh, plus the vertical velocity profile `u(zeta)` at three cross-sections below it — zeta = 0 at the bed, 1 at the free surface. Reconstructed from the moment state the same way the coupling contract lifts it. A depth-averaged run (SWE / level 0) shows a vertical line; raising `level` gives the profile shape.
